comment: The maker names no port. Both DIRECTION switches are dead: src/controller/Marionette.cpp:63 and :91 test PITCH_DECAY_PARAM and AMP_DECAY_PARAM against 1.0 rather than the switch parameters, which is what the shipped build does — pitchEnvelope loads params[0] and ampEnvelope params[4], never params[3] or params[7]. An input at index 6 (AMP_ATTACK_CV_IN) and an output at index 1 (ENVELOPE_OUT) are declared but given no widget and never read or written, so they get no line. BLEND is configured 0 to 10 (src/controller/Marionette.cpp:15) while the panel marks the knob 0 to 5. SUB MIX is configured 0 to 5 but read over a 0 to 10 span (src/controller/Marionette.cpp:140), so the knob alone cannot reach a full sub mix.
